sourceText.text: I built a system that takes a video idea,
and turns everything into a finished video.
For this demo, I'll quickly show you
the process and the final output.
The process starts with a simple request.
Now I can give it a short request,
and the system handles the rest of the process.
The first thing the system does
is look at this existing video library.
This library gives the system examples
It uses those references as inspiration
the system breaks the idea into individual shots.
For this video, it created four shots
Here, I am showing three of them:
For this project, the system chose HyperFrames
For other videos, it can use models
when the shot needs things like
The idea is to choose the method
instead of using the same model
Once the individual shots are ready,
they're combined into the final video.
The workflow then checks things like
This records how the video was made,
before the video can be marked complete.
And this is the final video
The next phase I'm working on
I'm keeping that research separate for now
while I continue testing and improving it.
